settings.autonomy.heading: Autonomy & self-improvement
settings.autonomy.subtitle: Background self-improvement loops. Enabled ones make paid LLM calls on a schedule (or when triggered) using your configured model provider. All are off by default — enabling any of them is your choice, and you can turn them off again at any time.
settings.autonomy.loop.proactiveHeartbea: Composes proactive briefings when things need your attention.
settings.autonomy.loop.nightlyReflection: Runs a nightly self-reflection pass to spot improvements in how the assistant is working.
settings.autonomy.loop.forgeProposals.de: Proposes tool/skill improvements learned from friction — still needs your approval before anything changes.
settings.autonomy.loop.selfLearning.desc: Proposes prompt/routing tweaks learned from usage metrics — still needs your approval before anything changes.
settings.autonomy.loop.skillAdoption.des: Proposes new skills learned from repeated patterns — still needs your approval before anything changes.

settings.dataPort.exportSoon: Export will produce an eyas-export-v1 bundle (vault, skills, workspaces).
settings.dataPort.wizard.title: Import data
settings.dataPort.wizard.pathHint: Absolute path on this machine — a folder or a whole home directory. Everything under it is mapped; nothing is capped or skipped in silence: every file and every folder class that is not entered is listed with its reason. Large trees take minutes to scan.
settings.dataPort.wizard.uploadHint: ZIP of a prior export, or a single markdown/JSON file
settings.dataPort.wizard.instructionsHin: Describe what to look for — tools, paths, memory versus skills. It only guides ranking; nothing is dropped because of it. A memory index (MEMORY.md) is imported as one note, not split into its entries.
settings.dataPort.wizard.instructionsPla: e.g. Claude and Grok memory should be under Obsidian; custom skills live in Claude…
settings.dataPort.wizard.needInput: Provide a server path or upload a file.
settings.dataPort.wizard.needSelection: Select at least one item to import.
settings.dataPort.wizard.enrichHint: Off by default. A model may suggest a kind, a summary and tags for notes that declare none — never the body, and nothing is dropped on its say-so. Needs a configured model.
settings.dataPort.wizard.resizeHint: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize
settings.dataPort.wizard.emptyScan: Nothing importable found in this location.
settings.dataPort.wizard.pollTimeout: No progress for 10 minutes — the server stopped reporting on this import. Check Previous imports: after a server restart the job is marked failed and can be rolled back. A long import keeps running on the server either way.
settings.dataPort.wizard.proposalsHint: Rules and identity files are never auto-merged. Approve to append into the agent workspace.
settings.dataPort.wizard.agentsWindowHin: The whole file is kept on disk; the model sees about the first 3 200 characters of AGENTS.md. Long rule files are better sent to the project-type prompt.
settings.dataPort.wizard.rollbackConfirm: Remove every note, skill, agent and approved rule section this import created?
settings.dataPort.reason.orphan-asset: Bundled file of a skill that was not imported
settings.dataPort.reason.not-downloaded: Stored in the cloud, not downloaded
settings.dataPort.reason.missing-unit: Its part of the file was gone
settings.dataPort.reason.source-code: Source code file — importable, not ticked
settings.dataPort.reason.data-file: Data or configuration text — importable, not ticked
settings.dataPort.reason.session-artifac: Tool output saved with a session
settings.dataPort.reason.exceeds-string-: Larger than one text value the engine can hold (about 512 MiB) — listed, not filed yet
settings.dataPort.wizard.tag.contains-se: Contains a secret — stored, hidden from recall
settings.dataPort.wizard.containsSecrets: Imported verbatim and tagged contains-secrets. Hidden from the model's memory recall unless memory.recall.includeSecrets is on.
settings.dataPort.wizard.promptVerbatimS: A persona or rule file is used verbatim in the assistant’s prompts, so a credential inside it reaches the model on every turn — recall filtering does not apply. Review these rows before importing.
settings.dataPort.wizard.warning.secrets: Secrets checked in the head only
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.instructio: Your instructions were applied to ranking and default selection
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.home-root-: Every folder under the home directory was mapped; {{skipped}} folders of excluded classes are listed as rows
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.directorie: {{count}} folders were listed as one row each and not entered: {{detail}}
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.large-file: {{count}} files are larger than usual — imported whole, marked
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.rows-passe: {{count}} files are listed as not importable (binary, duplicate, app state, unreadable) — each with its reason
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.symlink-cy: {{count}} symlink loops were detected and not re-entered
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.unreadable: {{count}} folders or files could not be read
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.scan-faile: The scan stopped with an error: {{detail}}. Everything mapped before it is still listed.
settings.dataPort.scanWarning.retention-: Old scans could not be tidied up; the scan itself is unaffected.
settings.dataPort.wizard.scanning.title: Mapping the tree…
settings.dataPort.wizard.scanning.failed: The scan stopped early. What was mapped can still be reviewed.
settings.dataPort.wizard.filter.label: Filter
settings.dataPort.wizard.tree.label: Folders found by the scan
settings.dataPort.wizard.tree.reasons: Reasons the rows in this folder carry
settings.dataPort.wizard.tree.keyboardHi: Arrow keys move, Space selects, Left and Right collapse or expand a folder, Enter opens it
settings.dataPort.wizard.tree.noMatches: No rows match the current filters.
settings.dataPort.wizard.treeError: The folder list could not be loaded. Try again, or narrow the filter.
settings.dataPort.wizard.list.label: Files in the selected folder
settings.dataPort.wizard.preview.title: Preview
settings.dataPort.wizard.preview.truncat: First {{shown}} of {{total}} shown — imported in full
settings.dataPort.wizard.preview.notDown: The bytes of this file are not on this machine, so there is nothing to preview. Previewing never downloads it — tick the row and import to fetch it.
settings.dataPort.wizard.countsError: Counts could not be loaded — the list still works.
settings.dataPort.wizard.resumeNotice: This import was interrupted by a restart and is being resumed from where it stopped.
settings.dataPort.wizard.cancelImportCon: Stop after the current batch? Everything already filed stays and can be rolled back.
